description: This file is a script designed to analyze source code files for the presence of raw fetch calls outside an allowlist, specifically for monitoring or enforcing code standards within a project. It imports TypeScript utilities and project-specific modules to parse source files, identify fetch calls, and run checks as a script.

methods.name: findRawFetchCallLines
methods.description: Analyzes code content to locate lines where raw fetch() calls are made outside the allowed list.

methods.description: Main entry point to execute the fetch call analysis and enforcement.
